facts: NOAA reports that ship repair and maintenance delays reduced sea days by about 75%.
A crew shortage reduced operations from 24 to 12 hours per day.
The survey focused on Georges Bank and sampled 70 of 377 planned trawl stations.
Stations were sampled during daytime only; NOAA says combining these observations with previous day/night data requires additional evaluation.
